IELTS SPEAKING
D
Event · Party · People · Argument
事件题怎么讲成一个好故事

怎么讲

  • 这节课是Part 2的事件类（Event）：三道题，一场派对、一次对讨厌的人客气、一次朋友间的争论。中间穿插一组“情绪词”，专门解决感受段说不出来的问题。
  • 开场先给学生一个预期：事件题的骨架都一样，点题 → 5W讲经过 → 讲感受，今天三道题都是这个骨架往里填内容。

怎么互动

  • 热身一问：What's the best party or event you've been to?每人30秒，老师只记下谁的答案停在“开心”就说不下去了，课末对比。

怎么迁移

  • 事件题在题库里占比很高：一次聚会、一次争论、一次迟到、一次学新技能、一次网购踩坑……今天的三步法都能直接套。
  • 封面图片（Wikimedia Commons）：Blake Lisk（CC0）、Sergei Solovev（CC0）、Francesca Cesa Bianchi（CC BY-SA 3.0 IT）、Levi Guzman（CC0）、Autumn Goodman（CC0）、perzon seo（CC BY 2.0）、Matthew Henry（CC0）、rawpixel.com（CC0）、PattayaPatrol（CC BY-SA 4.0）、Shwangtianyuan（CC BY-SA 4.0）、Aaron Burden（CC0）、Sofiya Levchenko（CC0）。Unsplash来源的图在Commons上均为CC0。

今天讲三道事件题
01

Describe a party that you enjoyed
+ 情绪词：喜怒哀惧
→ 第4–14页
02
Friendly to someone you dislike
讨厌一个人，却还得对他客气
→ 第15–23页

An argument
两个朋友争起来了，你是旁观者
→ 第24–34页

怎么讲

  • 按原稿的三块内容：Party → Friendly to someone you dislike → An argument。卡片下的中文说明和页码是我补的，方便你上课跳页。
  • 三张图对应三道题：后院的一场派对、一次客客气气的握手（心里未必喜欢对方）、两个人面对面各说各的理。

怎么互动

  • 请学生猜：三道题里哪一道最难？多数人会选第二道（讨厌的人），因为“讨厌”不好说，讲完后再投一次票看看有没有变化。

怎么迁移

  • 三道题分别代表三类事件：开心的事、尴尬的人际、观点冲突。以后遇到新题先判断属于哪类，再调用对应的素材。
  • 图片（Wikimedia Commons）：The party，Blake Lisk（Unsplash），CC0；握手，perzon seo，CC BY 2.0；Discussing business strategy，rawpixel.com（Unsplash），CC0。
Event
事件题三步走
01
点题
第一句就说清楚讲哪件事
  • Speaking of …, let me tell you about …
  • I'd like to share with you …
→
02
叙事要素5W
When · Where · Who · What · Why
  • 时间、地点、人物交代清楚
  • 经过按顺序讲：first … then … after that …
→
03
How do you feel
感受不止一句“很开心”
  • 时间轴：Before · Moment · After
  • 情绪词：喜 · 怒 · 哀 · 惧
三道题都用这个骨架，变的只是第二步里装什么

怎么讲

  • 原稿的三步是点题 → 叙事要素（5W）→ How do you feel。卡片下面的开头句、顺序词和“时间轴 / 情绪词”是我补的，把后面要讲的内容提前挂上钩。
  • 重点强调第三步：学生最常见的问题是讲完经过只说一句I was very happy就收尾了。后面的“时间轴法”和“情绪词”就是为了把感受说长。

怎么互动

  • 老师用三句话现场示范一件小事（比如“上周第一次用AI工具做PPT”）：点题一句、经过一句、感受一句。让学生指出每句属于哪一步。

怎么迁移

  • 三步法也是工作里讲“复盘”的结构：发生了什么 → 经过 → 收获和感受。Part 3问What makes an event memorable?时也能从“过程”和“感受”两头说。
Part 2 · Topic 01
Describe a party that you enjoyed
1
When it happened
2
Where it was held
3
What people did during the party
4
And explain how you felt about it

怎么讲

  • 四个提示问题照原稿。前两个是When / Where（第一段交代），第三个是经过，第四个是感受，正好对上三步走。
  • 左边两张图：上面是朋友在后院开派对（气球、乒乓球桌、边聊边玩），下面是派对的气球装饰。可以让学生先看图说出Where / Who / What，再看题目。

怎么互动

  • 快问快答：When was the last party you went to? Where was it?每人只答两句，下一页再一起想“派对有哪几种”。

怎么迁移

  • 同一个素材可以用在a celebration you attended / a happy event / a family gathering。职场学生可以讲公司年会或项目上线后的庆功宴（a launch party）。
  • 图片（Wikimedia Commons）：The party，Blake Lisk（Unsplash），CC0；Party balloons，Sofiya Levchenko（Unsplash），CC0。
Party
派对有哪几种？
Party
派对
1
生日派对Birthday party
turn 19满19岁blow out the candles吹蜡烛
2
单身派对Bachelor party
the groom's last night out婚前最后狂欢bachelorette party女生版
3
节日派对Holiday party
圣诞派对Christmas party跨年夜New Year's Eve狂欢节Carnival
4

5
惊喜派对Surprise party

+
公司年会Annual company party

怎么讲

  • 原稿的派对分类：Birthday、Bachelor、Holiday（Christmas、New Year's Eve、Carnival）、House-warming、Surprise。左侧名称先露中文，点开出英文；每行右边的小词组是我补的“能讲的细节”。
  • 最后一行“公司年会 / 庆功宴”是我补的，原稿没有，适合已经工作的学生，不需要可以跳过。
  • New Year's Eve本身就是“跨年夜”，说派对时完整说法是a New Year's Eve party。

怎么互动

  • 举手调查：每种派对谁参加过？选人数最多的一种，请一位学生用一句话说说当时在哪、和谁。
  • 点“全部揭晓”前，先让学生抢答英文说法。

怎么迁移

  • 选材建议：Birthday和Surprise最好讲，有明确的“高潮时刻”（吹蜡烛、开门那一下），感受段也最容易展开。
  • 科技商业版：一次黑客松结束后的庆功派对、一次线上跨年派对（an online New Year's Eve party on Zoom）。
Sample Answer · Party
when + where + who + occasion
点击挖空 Speaking of a party that I enjoyed, let me tell you about my last birthday party. Last November, I turned 19 and celebrated with my family and friends at home. Earlier that day, I invited a couple of my classmates over for dinner. However, they disappointed me by turning down my invitation, saying that they were all busy. I felt down in the dumps. It didn't feel like a special day at all until nighttime.
OccasionWhenWhoWhere埋个伏笔
点题
my last birthday
→
四要素
November · home · family
→
转折
they all said no
When · Where · Who · Occasion
What did you do
How did you feel
KEY PHRASES
Speaking of …说到……
invite sb. over请人来家里
turn down an invitation拒绝邀请
down in the dumps闷闷不乐
It didn't feel like …感觉不像……

怎么讲

  • 原稿给第一段的公式是when + where + who + occasion：哪个场合（生日）、什么时候、和谁、在哪。颜色对应图例。
  • 这段最妙的是埋伏笔：同学都说没空，“我”很失落，这就给后面的惊喜派对做了铺垫。告诉学生：先抑后扬，故事才有起伏。
  • 原稿订正（请确认）：I turned 19 and I celebrated → I turned 19 and celebrated（省掉重复主语，更顺）；Early that day → Earlier that day（“那天早些时候”）；I asked a couple of my classmates to my house to have dinner together → I invited a couple of my classmates over for dinner；refusing my invitation → turning down my invitation（refuse语法没错，turn down更口语）。

怎么互动

  • 点击段落挖空，学生看着图例复述；再请学生给自己的派对说出四要素，各用一个词就行。

怎么迁移

  • “先抑后扬”的开头适用于很多事件题：At first I thought the project launch would be a disaster, because …
Sample Answer · Party
What did you do?
点击挖空 It was about 7 pm when I arrived home. The moment I opened the door, I saw that my classmates and friends were all in the room waiting for me, smiling happily. Words couldn't describe how surprised I was.
时间
7 pm, home
→
关键一刻
opened the door
→
看到
everyone waiting
→
反应
speechless
KEY PHRASES
The moment I …,我一……就
Words couldn't describe …无法形容

怎么讲

  • 经过段的第一部分只讲一个画面：开门那一刻。The moment I opened the door, …是讲“高潮时刻”最好用的句型，比When I opened the door更有画面感。
  • 原稿订正（请确认）：原稿It was about 7 pm when I arrived home, the moment I opened the door, …是两个完整句用逗号连起来，改成句号断开；I saw my classmates and friends were all in the room → I saw that my classmates and friends were all in the room；I was out of words describing my surprise → Words couldn't describe how surprised I was.（没有be out of words的说法，也可以说I was lost for words）。
  • 右边两张实拍对应这一段的两个画面：上面是蛋糕端到面前的那一刻，下面是一屋子朋友围着蜡烛等你。可以指着图问What did you see the moment you opened the door?

怎么互动

  • 造句接力：每人用The moment I …, I …说一个自己的“高潮时刻”，比如The moment I got the offer email, I jumped out of my chair.

怎么迁移

  • 任何事件题都需要一个“关键一刻”：收到录取通知、看到考试成绩、产品第一次上线成功。先找到这一刻，再往前后展开。
  • 图片（Wikimedia Commons）：Happy Birthday!，Sergei Solovev（Unsplash），CC0；Friends gather around a glowing tray of candles，PattayaPatrol，CC BY-SA 4.0。
Sample Answer · Party
What did you do?
点击挖空 Right after I sat down, my friends turned the lights off and my parents brought a birthday cake into the room. They all sang "Happy Birthday" to me, both in Chinese and in English. They asked me to make a wish and to blow out the candles. After that, I shared the cake with everyone in the room. And later on, our faces were covered with cream, you know, just for fun. We did have a blast that day.
1
lights off
→
2
cake
→
3
song · wish
→
4
candles
→
5
cream on faces
When · Where · Who · Occasion
What did you do
How did you feel
KEY PHRASES
make a wish许愿
blow out the candles吹蜡烛
have a blast玩得超开心

怎么讲

  • 经过段第二部分是按顺序讲动作：关灯 → 推蛋糕 → 唱歌许愿 → 吹蜡烛 → 分蛋糕 → 抹奶油。黑色高亮是顺序词Right after / After that / And later on，让2分钟的独白有条理。
  • We did have a blast：did加强语气，“我们是真的玩疯了”。
  • 原稿订正（请确认）：Right after I sit down → Right after I sat down（全段过去时）；sang the birthday song for me → sang "Happy Birthday" to me（英语里直接说歌名更地道）；After that I shared → After that, I shared（加逗号）。

怎么互动

  • 把下面5个步骤打乱顺序念给学生，让他们用顺序词排回去并复述。
  • 挖空后两人一组，一人说动作，一人补顺序词。

怎么迁移

  • “顺序词 + 动作链”可以讲任何过程：一次搬家、一次新品发布会、第一次用App点外卖。Part 1问What do you usually do on your birthday?也可以借这一串动作。
  • 图片：Italy - birthday cake with candles，Francesca Cesa Bianchi / Wikimedia Commons，CC BY-SA 3.0 IT。
How did you feel?
时间轴法：感受分三段说
Before之前
事情发生前的心情：期待、紧张，或者像范例里一样失落。
looking forward tonervousdisappointed
Moment当下
关键那一刻的情绪最强烈，用最重的词。
thrilledspeechlessthe high point
After之后
事后回想：感激、怀念、学到了什么。
thankfulunforgettableI'll never forget …

怎么讲

  • 原稿的方法叫时间轴法：Before · Moment · After。感受不是一个点，而是一条线，三个时间点各说一句，感受段就有三四句了。
  • 上面的情绪曲线和卡片里的词是我按下一页范例画的：派对前失落（低点）→ 开门那一刻兴奋（最高点）→ 事后感激（回落但仍然很高）。

怎么互动

  • 请学生在白板上给自己选的派对画一条情绪曲线，标出三个点，再看着曲线说三句话。

怎么迁移

  • 时间轴法几乎适用所有事件题：一次面试（前紧张、当下手心冒汗、后松了口气）、一次产品发布（前焦虑、上线那刻激动、后很有成就感）。
Sample Answer · Party
How did you feel about it?
点击挖空 To be honest with you, before the party, when I found out that they couldn't make it, I was a little disappointed, even a bit heartbroken. But the moment I saw them in my place, I was thrilled. You know, it was the high point of a surprise party. I felt thankful after the party, and I couldn't thank them enough for the joy they had brought me. I just love them, and I will never forget this amazing party.
Before
disappointed
→
Moment
thrilled
→
After
thankful · never forget
When · Where · Who · Occasion
What did you do
How did you feel
KEY PHRASES
To be honest with you说实话
make it能来、赶得上
the high point最高潮
I couldn't thank them enough怎么感谢都不够
I will never forget …永远不会忘记

怎么讲

  • 颜色就是时间轴：蓝 = Before，橙 = Moment，绿 = After，三段各有一个情绪词。
  • 原稿订正（请确认）：after I knew that they couldn't make it → when I found out that they couldn't make it（“得知”用find out）；felt heart broken → heartbroken（一个词），另外原稿a little disappointed and felt heartbroken程度前后矛盾，改成a little disappointed, even a bit heartbroken；I was thrilled, you know, it was …逗号连了两个句子，断成两句；I couldn't express my appreciation for the pleasure that they've brought me → I couldn't thank them enough for the joy they had brought me（原句生硬，时态也应为过去完成）；never forget about this amazing party → never forget this amazing party。

怎么互动

  • 挖空复述，要求学生说的时候用手在空中“画”出情绪曲线：低 → 高 → 稍回落。
  • 把三段换成自己的派对，限时45秒说完感受段。

怎么迁移

  • I couldn't thank them enough在“感谢某人”的题里都能用：a person who helped you / a time someone gave you good advice。
如何用英语表达情绪？
喜Happy
程度：由轻到重（点击看中文）
pleased
满意、高兴
glad
高兴
delighted
很高兴
thrilled
兴奋极了
ecstatic
欣喜若狂
地道说法（猜猜什么意思）
be / feel over the moon
高兴得不得了
be in seventh heaven
快乐得像在天堂
be on cloud nine
乐得飘飘然
be on top of the world
春风得意，感觉站在世界之巅
walk on air
高兴得走路都发飘
When I got the job offer, I was over the moon.
例句：拿到offer时我高兴坏了

怎么讲

  • 原稿把情绪分成“喜怒哀惧”四页，先讲喜。上面一排是程度递进：pleased → glad → delighted → thrilled → ecstatic，越往右越强烈。感受段别总说very happy，按场景挑一个程度合适的词。
  • 下面是习语，点开看中文。原稿订正（请确认）：Be on the cloud nine → be on cloud nine（不加the）；Be on the top of the world → be on top of the world（固定说法不加the）。
  • 最后一张例句卡是我补的，示范习语怎么放进句子里。
  • 原稿这几页用的是卡通表情图，这里换成两张实拍：上面看表情，下面看场景。四页都是这个排法，可以先遮住单词，让学生看图说出程度词。

怎么互动

  • “程度排队”：把5个词写在卡片上打乱，请5位学生按强弱站成一排，其他人判断对不对。
  • 每人用一个习语说一件让自己over the moon的事，鼓励说科技商业场景：拿到offer、App上线、论文被接收。

怎么迁移

  • 习语一个回答里用一个就够，用多了像背书。Part 2感受段推荐结构：程度词 + 一个习语 + 原因，比如I was thrilled — honestly, I was on cloud nine, because …
  • 图片（Wikimedia Commons）：Mother Nature, Summer，Autumn Goodman（Unsplash），CC0；Orange sunset celebration，Levi Guzman（Unsplash），CC0。
如何用英语表达情绪？
怒Angry
程度：由轻到重（点击看中文）
annoyed
烦
irritated
恼火
offended
被冒犯
outraged
义愤填膺
furious
暴怒
地道说法（猜猜什么意思）
I lost my temper.
我发火了
go ballistic
暴跳如雷
I'm fed up with …
我受够了……
You've crossed the line.对人说
你过分了
Don't mess with me.对人说
别惹我
Watch your mouth!对人说
嘴巴放干净点
How dare you?对人说
你怎么敢！
I'm fed up with endless pop-up ads.
例句：没完没了的弹窗广告我受够了

怎么讲

  • 怒的程度词：annoyed → irritated → offended → outraged → furious。提醒一点：offended严格说是“被冒犯、不舒服”，偏“受伤”而不只是生气；outraged多用于对不公的事愤慨。原稿的顺序保留不动。
  • 后面四句标了“对人说”：You've crossed the line / Don't mess with me / Watch your mouth! / How dare you?是吵架时直接对对方说的狠话，考试里不要对考官说，但讲故事时可以引用：She looked at him and said, "You've crossed the line."
  • 原稿I am fed up with …这里写成口语缩写I'm；最后一张例句卡是我补的。
  • 右边两张图：上面是生气时的表情和手势，下面是对着电脑发火的场景，正好接下面“迁移”里那句I get really irritated when an app keeps crashing.

怎么互动

  • 情景配对：老师说一个场景，学生选最合适的程度词。快递迟到三天 → annoyed；室友半夜打游戏 → irritated；有人插队还骂人 → furious。
  • 两人一组用“对人说”的四句演一段10秒小冲突（注意语气，演完就笑）。

怎么迁移

  • 这一页正好接后面两道题：讨厌的人（I was fed up with his bragging）和争论（They didn't lose their temper, though）。
  • 科技话题：I get really irritated when an app keeps crashing.Part 1问What makes you angry?时可以用。
  • 图片（Wikimedia Commons）：Angry woman sitting on a sofa；Angry woman using laptop at home，均为Shixart1985，CC BY 2.0。
如何用英语表达情绪？
哀Sad
程度：由轻到重（点击看中文）
upset
难过、不痛快
down
情绪低落
blue
忧郁
depressed
消沉
miserable
痛苦不堪
地道说法（猜猜什么意思）
I feel devastated.
我崩溃了、悲痛欲绝
I feel down in the dumps.
我闷闷不乐
I feel heartbroken.
我心都碎了
I hit rock bottom.
我跌到了谷底
When I heard the news, my heart just sank.
听到消息，我的心一下子沉了下去
My laptop died the night before the deadline. I was devastated.
例句：截止前一晚电脑坏了

怎么讲

  • 哀的程度词：upset → down → blue → depressed → miserable。小提醒：depressed现在常让人联想到抑郁症，日常聊天说really down更稳妥；blue是口语里的“有点郁闷”。
  • 原稿这几句都在：devastated / down in the dumps / heartbroken / hit rock bottom / my heart just sank。第6页范例就用过down in the dumps，可以让学生回想是在哪里。最后一张例句卡是我补的。
  • 右边两张图：上面是很重的难过（heartbroken / devastated），下面是一个人坐在窗边看雨，是轻一点的blue / down。可以问学生：哪张更难过？用哪个词？

怎么互动

  • “心情温度计”：老师说一件事，学生用手指比1–5表示有多难过，再说出对应的词。比如手机屏幕碎了 → upset；没拿到想要的offer → down；被裁员 → devastated。

怎么迁移

  • “难过”常出现在Before段（先抑后扬）：I hit rock bottom after failing the exam, but …后面接转折，故事更有起伏。
  • 图片（Wikimedia Commons）：Sad girl with head in hands，U3239762，CC BY-SA 4.0；Lonely woman sitting near window，Shixart1985，CC BY 2.0。
如何用英语表达情绪？
惧Scared
程度：由轻到重（点击看中文）
scared
害怕
frightened
受惊
terrified
非常害怕
horrified
惊恐
petrified
吓呆了
地道说法（猜猜什么意思）
I was scared stiff.
吓得僵住了
scared to death
吓得要死
Sth. freaks me out.
……把我吓坏了
Sth. / sb. gives me the creeps.
……让我心里发毛
He is such a creep.
他真让人起鸡皮疙瘩
Sth. sends chills down my spine.
……让我脊背发凉
be like a deer caught in the headlights
吓得呆若木鸡
Hearing an AI copy my voice perfectly sent chills down my spine.
例句：AI把我的声音学得一模一样，我脊背发凉

怎么讲

  • 惧的程度词：scared → frightened → terrified → horrified → petrified。petrified本义是“石化”，吓到动不了。
  • 区分两个creep：Sth. gives me the creeps（某物让我发毛）；He is such a creep（他是个让人不舒服的怪人），这句可以接到下一题“讨厌的人”。
  • 原稿订正（请确认）：原稿句中大写不统一，Sth. /sb. Gives me the creeps → Sth. / sb. gives me the creeps，Sth. Sends chills down my spine → sends；Be like a deer …句中改为小写be。最后一张例句卡是我补的。
  • 右边两张图：上面是受惊的表情（瞪大眼睛、张着嘴、双手捧脸），下面是过山车往下冲的场景，正好接互动里的“恐惧排行榜”。最后一张例句卡换成AI模仿声音，接科技话题。

怎么互动

  • “恐惧排行榜”：每人说一件让自己freaks me out的事（蜘蛛、坐过山车、上台演讲、手机电量只剩1%），全班投票哪个最可怕。
  • like a deer caught in the headlights可以让学生现场演：被老师突然点名时的表情。

怎么迁移

  • Part 3科技题：Are you worried about AI? → Honestly, the idea of AI making decisions for us kind of freaks me out, because …
  • “害怕”放在Before段也很好用：第一次公开演讲前I was scared stiff，讲完之后I felt on top of the world，四种情绪可以串着用。
  • 图片（Wikimedia Commons）：Scared woman sits by window with hands on face，Shixart1985，CC BY 2.0；Excited people green rollercoaster，Aaron Burden（Unsplash），CC0。
Part 2 · Topic 02
Describe a time you were friendly to someone you don't like
You should say:
1
Who the person is
2
When and where you met
3
What you don't like about him / her
4
Why you were friendly to him / her

怎么讲

  • 四个提示照原稿：谁 → 怎么认识的 → 讨厌他什么 → 为什么还得客气。这题难在“讨厌”和“客气”的矛盾，前两点是铺垫，后两点才是重点。
  • 提醒学生：讨厌的理由要具体、有分寸，讲一两件小事（爱吹牛、抠门），别变成人身攻击，考官要听的是故事和情绪，不是骂人。
  • 海报《绿皮书》：Tony一开始看不惯Don，但Don是他的雇主，这一路他得客客气气地当司机，正好对上这道题的情境。

怎么互动

  • 匿名小调查：每人在纸上写一个“不得不客气的人”的身份（不写名字），老师收上来读，下一页一起归类。

怎么迁移

  • 相关题：a person you disagree with / a time you had to be polite / a difficult person you worked with。职场素材：难搞的客户、爱抢功的同事、要求很多的甲方。
  • 海报：绿皮书（豆瓣）。
Who the person is
这个人可以是谁？
A person
you don't like
一个你不喜欢的人
1
老板Boss
a demanding manager at my internship实习时要求很多的经理
2
老师Teacher
my strict maths teacher in high school高中很严的数学老师
3
小孩Child
my naughty little cousin调皮的小表弟
4
室友Roomie (roommate)
a roommate who games until 3 a.m.打游戏到凌晨三点的室友
…
还有谁？coworker · neighbor …
朋友的对象my best friend's boyfriend范例就是他

怎么讲

  • 原稿给的人选：Boss、Teacher、Child、Roomie、…。Roomie是roommate的口语说法。每行右边的具体人设是我补的，提醒学生人设越具体越好讲，不要只说“a teacher”。
  • 最后一行“…”点开是我补的其他人选（同事、邻居），以及后面范例里的人：好朋友的男朋友。
  • 选人建议：选一个你必须常见面、又不能撕破脸的人，后面第四点“为什么要客气”才有话说。

怎么互动

  • 把上一页收上来的匿名答案逐个归到这五类里，看哪类最多。
  • 每人用一句话介绍自己的人选：The person I'm going to talk about is …, who …

怎么迁移

  • 职场版人选：一个总在最后一刻改需求的客户、一个开会爱打断别人的同事。同一个人物也能用在a person who often annoys you这类题。
Sample Answer · A person you don't like
Who the person is?
点击挖空 The person I'm gonna talk about is Nick, who I don't like, but I have to be friendly to. To be more precise, he is the boyfriend of my BFF Grace. I have to say that the first time I saw him, he made a pretty good impression on me because he is so handsome. He is tall and well-built, and he always wears a smile on his face, which makes him seem very polite. But the longer I know him, the more I dislike him.
他是谁点题第一印象转折
身份
my BFF's boyfriend
→
第一印象
handsome · polite
→
转折
the longer … the more …
Who the person is
When and where you met
What you don't like
Why you were friendly
KEY PHRASES
To be more precise更准确地说
the longer …, the more …越……越……

怎么讲

  • 第一段的套路：点题 → 身份 → 好的第一印象 → 转折。先夸再转，the longer I know him, the more I dislike him一句就把后面的故事勾出来了。
  • BFF = best friend forever（闺蜜、铁哥们）；gonna是going to的口语形式，口语考试可以说。
  • 原稿订正（请确认）：the first I saw him → the first time I saw him（漏了time）；he has left a pretty good impression on me → he made a pretty good impression on me（过去的事用过去时，make an impression更常用）；which makes him a very polite person → which makes him seem very polite（笑容让他“显得”有礼貌，后文他其实并不好）；He is tall and well-built. And he always …合成一句。
  • 右边的照片就是Nick给人的第一印象：个子高、穿得精神、脸上总挂着笑。先让学生用图描述外貌（tall, well-built, always smiling），再读范例。

怎么互动

  • 造句：每人用The longer …, the more …说一句，比如The longer I use this app, the more I like it.
  • 挖空复述后，让学生给自己的人物写“先夸再转”的三句话。

怎么迁移

  • “第一印象vs. 真实的他”可以用在a person who changed your opinion of them；Part 3可能问Are first impressions reliable?
  • 图片：Man with crossed arms，Warren Wong（Unsplash） / Wikimedia Commons，CC0。
Sample Answer · A person you don't like
When and where you met
点击挖空 Well, we've only met, like, a couple of times. Of course, the only reason that we met is Grace. I remember the first time Grace introduced him to me, it was around six months ago. That was when they had just started dating, and Grace wanted me to meet her boyfriend. So we had dinner together at a restaurant near my campus.
WhenWhereWhy · 怎么认识的What
见过几次
a couple of times
→
为什么认识
because of Grace
→
第一次
six months ago
→
在哪
near my campus
Who the person is
When and where you met
What you don't like
Why you were friendly
KEY PHRASES
introduce sb. to me介绍给我认识
start dating开始交往
near my campus学校附近

怎么讲

  • 这一段就是5W：见过几次 → 为什么会认识 → 什么时候 → 在哪里 → 做了什么。短、清楚，交代完就进入下一段的“讨厌他什么”。
  • like在这里是口语填充词（“大概”），前后加逗号，说的时候稍停一下，听起来很自然。
  • 原稿订正（请确认）：we only met like a couple of times → we've only met, like, a couple of times（到现在为止见过几次，用现在完成时）；it was like around 6 months ago → it was around six months ago（like和around重复）；That was the time they started their relationship and Grace wanted me to have a look at her boyfriend → That was when they had just started dating, and Grace wanted me to meet her boyfriend（have a look at像在看东西）；had a dinner together in a restaurant → had dinner together at a restaurant。

怎么互动

  • 挖空复述后，两人互问：How did you meet this person? / When was the first time?每人答4句。

怎么迁移

  • “怎么认识的”这段可以直接复用到所有人物题：a friend you made recently / a colleague you work well with。职场版：We first met at a product meeting about six months ago.
  • 图片：Zuo Ting You Yuan Hot Pot at Nanxiang Incity Mega，Shwangtianyuan / Wikimedia Commons，CC BY-SA 4.0。
What you don't like
Reasons you don't like someone
Reason
为什么不喜欢
Teachers老师
太严格too strict没耐心impatient喜怒无常moody
Boss老板
爱发号施令bossy固执己见self-willed
Kid小孩
调皮捣蛋naughty没礼貌impolite
5W
+1H
挑一个理由

怎么讲

  • 原稿按人分类给了讨厌的理由：老师（too strict、impatient、moody）、老板（bossy、self-willed）、小孩（naughty、impolite）。先露中文，点开出英文。
  • 右边大括号指向5W+1H：光说He is bossy只有一句，要用5W+1H讲一件具体的事（什么时候、在哪、他做了什么），理由才立得住。下一页范例就是这样讲的。
  • self-willed偏书面，口语里也可以说stubborn或he never listens to anyone。

怎么互动

  • “一词变一事”：学生抽一个词（比如moody），30秒内用5W+1H讲一件小事来证明，比如Last week my teacher was all smiles in the morning, but in the afternoon she yelled at us for …

怎么迁移

  • 职场形容词补充：micromanaging（事无巨细都要管）、takes credit for others' work（抢功）、always late for meetings。也能用在Part 3：What makes a good boss?反过来说就是答案。
Sample Answer · A person you don't like
What you don't like about him
点击挖空 I remember the first time we had dinner, he bragged a lot and told us how many girls liked him, and how many gifts he'd received from loads of girls. Hearing this, I started to see him as a bit of a playboy. What's worse, at the end of the dinner, Nick said he had to make a private phone call right away and walked away. He didn't come back until Grace texted him to say we had paid for the meal.

→

Who the person is
When and where you met
What you don't like
Why you were friendly
KEY PHRASES
brag吹牛
loads of …一大堆
see sb. as …把某人看作
What's worse, …更糟的是
pay for the meal买单

怎么讲

  • 这一段用了两件事来撑“讨厌”：第一件吹牛，第二件逃单，中间用What's worse升级。比只说He is arrogant and stingy生动得多，这就是上一页说的“用5W+1H讲成一件事”。
  • 原稿订正（请确认）：the first time we have dinner → we had dinner；how many girls like him → liked him（时态一致）；consider him as a sort of playboy → see him as a bit of a playboy（consider后面不加as，see sb. as更口语）；Grace sent a message to him, which said we had paid the meal → Grace texted him to say we had paid for the meal（pay for the meal，text sb.更口语）。

怎么互动

  • 挖空复述后，请学生用What's worse, …给自己的人物加一件“更过分”的事。
  • 讨论：Nick这种“打电话躲买单”的行为，英语里还能怎么说？（He always conveniently disappears when the bill comes.）

怎么迁移

  • 职场版的“两件事升级”：He took credit for my slides in the meeting. What's worse, he blamed me when the client wasn't happy.
Sample Answer · A person you don't like
一句话总结他的印象
点击挖空 I didn't think less of him until I found out it was just an excuse. Grace told me he always did this when they had dinner with friends. That was the impression he made on me. You know, a stingy playboy.
第一印象
handsome · polite
→
第一件事
bragging
→
第二件事
skipping the bill
→
结论
a stingy playboy

怎么讲

  • 讨厌段的收尾：用一个短语给人下结论。a stingy playboy（抠门的花花公子），前面两件事一个对应playboy、一个对应stingy，前后呼应。
  • think less of sb. = 对某人评价变低、看轻某人。I didn't think less of him until …的意思是“直到……我才开始看不起他”。
  • 下面的印象变化条是我补的：好印象 → 两件事 → 结论，正好是第17–21页的整条线。
  • 原稿订正（请确认）：until I knew it was just a kind of excuse → until I found out it was just an excuse（“发现”用find out，a kind of多余）；And Grace told me he always did this when they had some dinners before → Grace told me he always did this when they had dinner with friends（some dinners不自然）。

怎么互动

  • “一个短语总结”：每人给自己的人物起一个“形容词 + 名词”的外号，比如a bossy know-it-all（爱指挥人的万事通）、a moody perfectionist，全班猜他做过什么事。

怎么迁移

  • 这种“一句话总结”在人物题里都好用，褒义也行：You know, a true team player.Part 3问What qualities do people dislike in others?时可以从stingy、arrogant说起。

为什么还得对他客气？

1

出于尊重respect他权力更大he has more power

怎么讲

  • 原稿给的原因：上级（尊重、他权力更大）、亲戚（断不了关系）、室友（住同一间）、…。先露中文，点开出英文。
  • 原稿订正（请确认）：Can't cut off → you can't cut ties with family（cut off后面要接宾语，“断绝关系”是cut ties with）；Live in a room → we share a room（live in a room只是“住在一个房间里”，表达不出“同住”）。

  • 每人给自己的人物选一个原因，用I have to be friendly to him simply because …说一句，再加一句“如果不客气会怎样”。

怎么迁移

  • Part 3常问：Is it important to be polite to people you don't like?可以从这几类原因展开：工作需要（higher-up、coworker）、家庭和睦（relative）、生活方便（roomie）。

Why I have to be friendly to him
点击挖空 Well, why do I have to be friendly to him? Simply because he is my best friend's boyfriend. She loves him a lot, so of course I can't say mean things about him. So can you imagine how difficult it is for me to put a smile on my face when he brags? So, I guess that's pretty much all about Nick, who I don't like at all.

→

Who the person is
When and where you met

Why you were friendly
KEY PHRASES
Simply because …只是因为
say mean things about sb.说某人坏话
put a smile on my face强颜欢笑
That's pretty much all about …关于……就这些

怎么讲

  • 结尾段：自问 → 原因 → 我的难处 → 收尾。用一个问句why do I have to …?开头，像在和考官聊天，很自然。
  • Can you imagine how difficult it is …?是把“情绪”放进反问里，比直接说It's difficult更有感染力。最后一句That's pretty much all about …是Part 2万能收尾。
  • 原稿订正（请确认）：标题Why I have to be friendly to him?去掉问号（这是题卡式的从句）；Well, why I have to be friendly to him, simply because … → Well, why do I have to be friendly to him? Simply because …（问句要倒装）；the boyfriend of my best friend → my best friend's boyfriend；She loves him a lot, of course, I can't say lots of mean words of him → She loves him a lot, so of course I can't say mean things about him；how difficult for me to put a smile → how difficult it is for me to put a smile（漏了it is）；that's pretty much about Nick who … → that's pretty much all about Nick, who …。

怎么互动

  • 三人一组，把第17–23页拼成一个完整的2分钟答案，每人负责一段，计时接力。
  • 请学生用Can you imagine how … it is for me to …?说一句自己的“难处”。

怎么迁移

  • 职场版：Why do I have to be nice to him? Simply because he's our biggest client. Can you imagine how hard it is to keep smiling when he changes the plan for the fifth time?
Part 2 · Topic 03
Describe an argument two of your friends had
1
When it happened
2
What it was about
3
How it was solved
4
And how you felt about it

怎么讲

  • 注意题目是两个朋友之间的争论，你是旁观者。重点是“他们为什么争、怎么解决的、你怎么看”，不要讲成自己和别人吵架。
  • 原稿订正（请确认）：原稿写成问句When it happened? / How you fell about it?，改成题卡的标准写法（不带问号）；fell（摔倒）→ felt（感觉），并补上题卡常见的And。
  • 左边两张图：上面是两个朋友坐着聊天，下面是两个人面对面各说各的理。正好对应“你是旁观者”：争论发生在朋友之间，你在旁边听，最后说说自己的看法。

怎么互动

  • 先问：最近身边的朋友为什么事争过？收集三五个，后面讲Cause时直接分类。

怎么迁移

  • 相关题：a disagreement with a coworker / a time you changed your mind / a debate you watched。职场里的争论可以是：whether our team should use AI tools to write reports。
  • 图片：Friends talking over tea，Matthew Henry / Wikimedia Commons（Unsplash），CC0；Discussing business strategy，rawpixel.com / Wikimedia Commons（Unsplash），CC0。
Argument
Argument的两个意思
意思1 · 论证、论点
An argument is a statement or set of statements that you use in order to try to convince people that your opinion about something is correct.
摆道理说服别人
意思2 · 争吵、争论
An argument is a conversation in which people disagree with each other angrily or noisily.
意见不合、吵起来了
Cause
为什么争 → 第26–28页
↓
Solution
怎么解决 → 第29–30页
↓
Feelings
你的感受 → 第31–32页
这道题：两个朋友意见不合（意思2），但各自都在摆道理（意思1）

怎么讲

  • 原稿给了argument的两个英文释义。这道题两个意思都沾一点：朋友意见不合（意思2），但各自在摆道理（意思1）。所以范例讲的是一场“有理有据的争论”，不是吵架骂人，更好讲也更安全。
  • 右边是原稿的三段结构：Cause → Solution → Feelings，页码是我加的。

怎么互动

  • 判断题：老师说几个场景（两个同事争论方案选A还是B / 两个人在路上因为刮车吵起来），学生举牌1或2，判断是哪个意思。

怎么迁移

  • 意思1在Part 3很有用：The main argument for remote work is that it saves commuting time.（支持远程办公的主要论点是……）
Cause of argument
朋友会为什么争起来？
Argument
Cause
1
Plan计划
团建聚餐订哪家店which restaurant to book for a team dinner
2
Misunderstanding误会
一条微信被误读a WeChat message was misread
3
Means方法
减肥靠运动还是节食exercise or diet范例
4
Content内容
新手机值不值这个价whether a new phone is worth the price
5
Ideas观点
AI会不会抢走工作whether AI will take our jobs

怎么讲

  • 原稿给了争论的五类起因：Plan（计划）、Misunderstanding（误会）、Means（方法）、Content（内容）、Ideas（观点）。原稿Misunder-standing是排版断行，这里写成完整单词。
  • 每类后面的例子是我补的，点击揭晓英文。后面的范例属于第3类Means：减肥靠运动还是节食。
  • 建议学生选Means或Ideas：双方都有道理，容易讲出“各自的论据”，也不涉及人身冲突。

怎么互动

  • 把开场收集到的“朋友争论的事”逐个归到五类里，看哪类最多。
  • 两人一组选一个Ideas类话题（如Should students use ChatGPT for homework?），各站一边说一句理由，现场演一场小争论。

怎么迁移

  • 科技商业类的“观点之争”素材：remote work vs. office work / buying vs. renting a car / Android vs. iPhone / paying with phones vs. cash。
Sample Answer · Argument
What it was about?
点击挖空 I'd like to share with you an argument my friends had last year. The argument was about which one helps more in terms of losing weight, doing exercise or going on a diet. During the COVID-19 pandemic, because of the lockdown, we didn't engage in much physical exercise. Apart from this, we ate a lot. Many of us gained lots of weight during that period. Hence, I asked a couple of my friends to work out at the gym to lose weight.
点题
exercise or diet
→
背景
lockdown · ate a lot
→
起因
work out at the gym
When · What it was about
How it was solved
How you felt about it
KEY PHRASES
in terms of …在……方面
gain weight长胖
work out健身

怎么讲

  • 第一段：点题（争什么）→ 背景（为什么会聊到这个）→ 起因（我拉朋友去健身房）。背景交代得好，争论就显得自然。
  • 原稿订正（请确认）：doing exercise or keeping diet → doing exercise or going on a diet（“节食”是go on a diet，没有keep diet的说法）；the corona pandemic → the COVID-19 pandemic（更规范）；work out in the gym → work out at the gym（更常用的介词）。

怎么互动

  • 挖空复述。追问全班：Which do you think helps more?举手站队，正好给下一页的“两方观点”热身。

怎么迁移

  • 同样的“背景 → 起因”可以讲职场争论：Last year our team argued about whether to build our own app or use a ready-made platform. Because the budget was tight …
  • 图片：Gym workout machines，Samson Ssemakadde / Wikimedia Commons，CC0。
Sample Answer · Argument
What it was about：两方观点
点击挖空 On our way to the gym, we started a topic: Which helps more with losing weight, doing sports or dieting? Two of my friends, Alice and Mary, held completely different opinions. Alice said exercise was more important for losing weight, while Mary countered her view by saying that diet was more significant for maintaining an ideal weight. They were smart and had good reasoning and logic. It seemed that neither of them could easily convince the other, and they used all the expertise they had to rebut each other.
When · What it was about
How it was solved
How you felt about it
Alice
Exercise is more important.
VS
Mary
Diet matters more.
KEY PHRASES
hold different opinions意见不同
counter one's view反驳
rebut驳斥
neither … the other谁也说服不了谁

怎么讲

  • 这段的核心是两方观点并列：Alice said … while Mary countered …。蓝色是Alice，绿色是Mary；右边VS卡是我补的可视化。
  • 好用的“争论词”：held completely different opinions / countered her view / had good reasoning and logic / rebut。
  • 原稿订正（请确认）：Which one helps more to lose weight, doing sports or having diet? → Which helps more with losing weight, doing sports or dieting?；Alice said weight-loss exercise was more important. While Mary countered his view … → 合成一句Alice said exercise was more important for losing weight, while Mary countered her view …（while开头的半句不能单独成句；Alice是女生，his → her）；neither of them could convince each other easily → neither of them could easily convince the other；And they literally used up all the expertise they had as rebuttals → and they used all the expertise they had to rebut each other（literally和as rebuttals搭配不自然）。

怎么互动

  • 角色扮演：两位学生分别演Alice和Mary，各说两条理由（可以去第33页找论据）；第三位学生当“我”，用Alice said … while Mary countered …把争论转述出来。

怎么迁移

  • 换成科技争论：Tom said AI tools would make us lazy, while Lily countered his view by saying they free us up for more creative work.
Solution
争论怎么收场？
Vote
投票，少数服从多数
适合一群人、选项很明确：去哪吃、看哪部片
We took a vote, and most of us agreed with Mary.
范例用的是这种
Authority
请权威、专业人士来评判
适合有“标准答案”的问题：健康、法律、技术
We asked an expert for professional advice.
Third Choice
找第三个方案，两边都满意
适合两边都有道理、可以折中的问题
In the end, we found a third option that worked for both of them.

怎么讲

  • 原稿给了三种收场方式：Vote（投票）、Authority（请权威）、Third Choice（第三方案）。中文解释、“适合”说明和每张卡的例句是我补的。
  • 下一页范例用的是Authority：请健身教练给专业意见，最后“我”又提出两者结合，其实还带了一点Third Choice。

怎么互动

  • 回到第26页大家编的小争论，每组选一种方式把它“收场”，用卡片上的例句说出来。

怎么迁移

  • 职场版：Vote → We held a quick poll in the team chat；Authority → We asked our manager / checked the data；Third Choice → We ran an A/B test to try both。Part 3问How should companies resolve disagreements?时很好用。
Sample Answer · Argument
How it was solved
点击挖空 To end this argument, we asked the fitness instructor for professional advice. He said both working out and dieting could help, but diet plays a more important role than physical exercise in losing weight. However, I believe it would be more efficient if we exercise and diet at the same time. Of course, it is never an easy thing.
Authority
ask the instructor
→
结论
diet plays a bigger role
→
我的看法
do both
When · What it was about
How it was solved
How you felt about it
KEY PHRASES
professional advice专业意见
play a role in …在……中起作用
efficient效率高

怎么讲

  • 结构：请权威 → 权威的结论 → 我自己的看法。最后一句Of course, it is never an easy thing.很口语，让答案有人味。
  • 原稿订正（请确认）：To end up this argument → To end this argument（end up是“最终落得”）；both workout and diet could be helpful, however, diet plays … → both working out and dieting could help, but diet plays …（原句用逗号连两个完整句，前后词性也要一致）；for losing weight → in losing weight（play a role in）；if we do exercise and keep diet → if we exercise and diet at the same time。

怎么互动

  • 挖空复述，再用Vote或Third Choice重说一遍这次争论的结局，比较哪种更好讲。

怎么迁移

  • “请权威”在科技话题里可以是“查数据”：To settle it, we checked the data on our fitness app — it showed that …
  • 图片：Chicken Cobb Salad，Nan Palmero / Wikimedia Commons，CC BY 2.0。
Feeling
感受从三方面说
Feeling
How you felt about it
1
The thing itself这件事本身
Beautiful美好Unique独特
2
Meaning意义
It made me think …补充I learned that …补充
3
Your emotion你的情绪
Happy喜Sad哀Scared惧→ 第11–14页情绪词

怎么讲

  • 原稿把感受分成三方面：事情本身（美好、独特）→ 意义 → 你的情绪（开心、难过、害怕）。派对题偏重第1、3类，争论题最适合讲第2类Meaning。
  • 第3行可以直接调用第11–14页的“喜怒哀惧”情绪词，最后那张跳页卡是我加的。
  • 原稿订正（请确认）：Things itself → The thing itself（单复数不一致）。Meaning这一行原稿没有给词，It made me think … / I learned that …是我补的两个开头。

怎么互动

  • 老师说一个事件（一次派对、朋友吵架、收到道歉），学生分别从三方面各说一句感受，看哪一方面最好说。

怎么迁移

  • Meaning是通往Part 3的桥：说完I learned that people see things differently，考官很可能接着问Why do people have different opinions?
Sample Answer · Argument
How you felt about it
点击挖空 Anyway, I was grateful that I got to listen to their argument. It gave me an opportunity to ponder on this topic. We don't just live to eat; we also live to think. Arguments make our lives more meaningful and diverse.
情绪
grateful
→
意义
ponder on this topic
→
升华
meaningful and diverse
When · What it was about
How it was solved
How you felt about it
KEY PHRASES
I was grateful that …很庆幸、很感激
ponder on …思考、琢磨
live to think为思考而活

怎么讲

  • 结尾段很短，但三层都有：情绪（grateful）→ 意义（让我思考）→ 升华（争论让生活更丰富），对上第31页的Your emotion和Meaning。
  • We don't just live to eat; we also live to think.是很好记的金句，可以借来收尾别的话题。
  • 右边“6和9”是原稿配图的意思（原稿是一张两人对着一个数字争论的卡通图），这里改画成简图：同一个数字，站在两边看，一个是6、一个是9，两个人都没错，这正是这段感受的核心。
  • 原稿订正（请确认）：I was appreciative that I could listen to them arguing → I was grateful that I got to listen to their argument（appreciative that偏生硬）；We don't just live to eat we also live to think → 中间加分号；Argument makes our lives more meaningful and diversified → Arguments make our lives more meaningful and diverse（泛指用复数；diversified多用于投资、业务的“多元化”）。

怎么互动

  • “金句改写”：把We don't just live to …; we also live to …改成别的话题，比如We don't just use phones to chat; we also use them to learn.每人造一句。
  • 请学生解释一下“6和9”：Who is right?引出Both of them are right — it depends on where you stand.

怎么迁移

  • 职场版收尾：Disagreements in a team aren't always bad — they often lead to better decisions.Part 3问Is it good to argue with others?时也能用。
Ideas bank
10 things you need to know about losing weight
1
Don't skip meals.
别不吃饭
2
Use smaller plates.
用小一点的盘子
3
Count your calories.
计算卡路里
4
Don't blame your metabolism.
别怪代谢慢
5
Protein staves off hunger pangs.
蛋白质能挡住一阵阵的饥饿感
6
Soup keeps you feeling fuller for longer.
喝汤让饱腹感更持久
7
The wider the choice, the more you eat.
选择越多，吃得越多
8
Low-fat dairy helps you excrete more fat.
低脂乳制品帮助排出更多脂肪
9
Exercise goes on burning fat, even while you sleep.
运动后睡觉时也在燃脂
10
Keep moving and lose weight.
多动才能瘦

怎么讲

  • 这是原稿给的“减肥知识”，当作争论范例的论据库：Mary（饮食派）可以用第1–8条（黑色编号），Alice（运动派）可以用第9、10条（蓝色编号）。
  • 点击每条看中文（中文是我补的）。原稿是小写短语，这里改成句首大写加句号，low fat dairy加连字符写成low-fat dairy。
  • 难词：stave off（抵挡、延缓）、hunger pangs（一阵阵的饥饿感）、excrete（排出）、metabolism（新陈代谢）。

怎么互动

  • “分阵营”：全班分成运动派和饮食派，每派从10条里挑两条当论据，派代表用I think … because …辩一轮，老师当Authority来裁决。正好把第28–30页演一遍。

怎么迁移

  • 可以接健康科技：Fitness apps and smartwatches help people count calories and track their steps.Part 3问Does technology make people healthier?时用得上。
Practice · Part 2
Describe a time someone apologized to you
1
Who the person is
点题：When · Who · 什么关系
2
What he / she did
经过：按顺序讲，找到“关键一刻”
3
Why he / she apologized
原因 + 怎么道歉的（当面、发消息、请吃饭）
4
And how you felt about it
Before · Moment · After ＋ 情绪词
60
Practice makes perfect.

怎么讲

  • 最后一道Part 2实战，把今天的三步法全部用上。每题下面的提示是我补的，对应前面的结构；右边计时器的“1分钟准备 + 2分钟独白”按考试真实时长设置。
  • 原稿订正（请确认）：题目Describe a time someone apologize to you → apologized；What did he/she do → What he / she did；Why he apologize → Why he / she apologized；How did you feel → And how you felt about it（题卡用陈述语序）。
  • 原稿这页配的是一张“Practice Makes Perfect”便利贴图，这里改成计时器下的一行字。
  • 素材建议：同事错过截止日期向你道歉、外卖送错了单、朋友迟到了一个小时。道歉的方式是很好的细节。

怎么互动

  • 三人一组轮换：一人说，一人计时，一人对照四个提示打勾，看有没有漏掉感受段。
  • 最后请说得最完整的同学示范，全班点评感受段用了哪几个情绪词、有没有用时间轴。

怎么迁移

  • 商业版：a time a company apologized to you——网购收到坏的商品，客服主动道歉并退款。Part 3可能问Why is it important for businesses to apologize to customers?
Thanks a lot!
Event三步点题 → 5W → How do you feel
PartyOccasion · 先抑后扬 · Before / Moment / After
情绪词喜 · 怒 · 哀 · 惧，由轻到重挑一个
讨厌的人 · 争论先夸再转 · Cause / Solution / Feelings

怎么讲

  • 1分钟回顾：三道题看起来不同，骨架都是“点题 → 5W → 感受”，只是中间那段换了内容（派对讲动作链、讨厌的人讲两件事、争论讲两方观点和解决）。
  • 原稿结尾只有“Thanks a lot!”，四张回顾卡是我补的。原稿没有作业页。
  • 封面同款图片，署名见第1页讲法。

怎么互动

  • 回到开场热身：每人用今天的三步再讲一次“印象最深的派对或活动”，和课前对比，看感受段说长了多少。

怎么迁移

  • 课后挑战（科技商业方向）：Describe a time you used technology to solve a problem / Describe a successful team project / Describe an online shopping experience that went wrong，都用三步法各准备一个2分钟答案。
TEACHING NOTES
